notes.title: Valley of the foxes huge update
notes.content:
Hello guys!

Sorry for the lack of updates! From this day I'll make sure to post them regularly and I would really appreciate your feedback.

You may be wondering what happened with valley of the foxes, well I've been improving everything to make sure that this game can compete with one of the best games on the steam.

Some of the main changes are:
I've reworked multiplayer framework and reworked whole map which is now island 16km squared. More about this in future updates.
No longer you play from third perspective, instead I've decided to put game into first perspective. This makes gameplay much smoother and accurate. 
Player building ability is removed from the game and vehicles instead will be added.
There are new game ideas being implemented at the moment which will make this game stand out from the rest. I'll also post this in future updates. 

I am sorry that this is taking so long time to finish but I will NOT release the game until I think you will be satisfied with the gameplay.

(Pictures/Video on the steam page are no longer accurate representation of the game)

Thanks for reading,
your developer!
